instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: But it is too soon to say, add a button to make rewards bigger and bring world peace. The two were separate experiments. We cannot say the choices alone caused the different results. We do not know if giving people a choice to make rewards bigger can stop meanness. The experiment looked only at brief boredom. It also looked only at actions that made another person's rewards smaller. We cannot use its results directly to explain everyday meanness or boredom that lasts a long time. Even so, we see boring moments a little differently now. We can ask not only, what mustn't I do, but also, what else can I do instead? Before we look at someone's personality, we can look at the menu in front of us. The stone may not move for five minutes, but the question we ask changes a little.
